$meta.description: Registry for Operation A (content-pages mesh): per content page, identity, section inventory, and the related-terms list with dispositions toward visual tools. Stores only cross-app data invisible from any single file. Backlinks are earned by demonstration value; mechanical reciprocity with Line 2 is forbidden.

conventions.pageKey: route-qualified key '<section>/<slug>' (e.g. 'trigonometry/identities', 'set-theory/operations') - bare slugs collide across sections
conventions.template: titled (sections have real slug ids) | untitled (empty section titles, structure investigation required before planting)
conventions.relatedTerms: Built on first mapping: prose scanned against definitionsRepository + formulasRepository (own section), plus each section's central subject. Status: linked | dropped (reason) | deferred (no ready tool demonstrates it; re-query as tools mature) | pending (must not survive a pass).
conventions.units: A linked term carries link records; unit is null for link-only plants (tool fits, visual does not - in-situ illustration later) or {diagrams, arrangement: single|sequence|adjacent-sections, newStates}. Visual form (2026-07-30): one attached frame - SVG left, tinted explanation panel right with divider, link inside the panel text. Built by app/components/demo-unit/demoUnitFrame.js inside getStaticProps, passed via props, rendered as a content-array item with dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Never interpolated into sectionsContent strings.
conventions.conceptToolMap: Site-wide best-demonstrating-tool decisions, written the first time a concept is linked anywhere, obeyed by every later pass.
conventions.populationRule: Universal registry rule: any pass touching a page updates its registry entry as a by-product, whatever the operation.

basis.why: Coordinates in a chosen basis are the tool subject.

cofactor_matrix.why: The adjugate route to the inverse.

column_space.why: One of the four spaces the tool draws.

dimension.why: Collapse from plane to line as independence fails is dimension made visible.

eigenspace.why: Repeated-eigenvalue state shows the whole space.

eigenvalue.why: Characteristic-polynomial roots; the symbolic route readers meet first.

eigenvector.why: Invariant directions are best seen geometrically.

linear_transformation.why: The grid deforming under the matrix is the concept.

matrix.why: The generator shows what a matrix is and what kinds exist.

orthogonal_complement.why: The orthogonality pairing between the four spaces is a state of the tool.

orthogonal_vectors.why: Orthogonality reads off the inner product being zero.

pivot.why: Pivots are highlighted at each elimination step.

positive_definite_matrix.why: The not-positive-definite state is the failure the tool shows.

projection.why: Vector-onto-vector is the elementary case; projection-2d is the matrix view.

reduced_row_echelon_form.why: A named stage of the tool.

row_echelon_form.why: A named stage of the tool.

row_space.why: One of the four spaces the tool draws.

scalar.why: Scaling is the whole content of the tool.

similar_matrices.why: Same map in two bases is what similarity means.

singular_matrix.why: Zero determinant is where singularity appears.

span.why: Is b in the span - the tool answers exactly this.

subspace.why: Membership test against a spanned set is the tool question.

unit_vector.why: Normalisation is a state of the magnitude tool.

vector.why: Arrows built component by component; the most basic place a vector is seen acting.

vector_space.why: Closure under combination is what the span region shows.
